segments.contextAfter: `enabled`: A Boolean value that indicates whether to receive notifications or indications whenever the characteristic’s value changes. [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) if you want to enable notifications or indications for the characteristic’s value. [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false) if you don’t want to receive notifications or indications whenever the characteristic’s value changes.
